title: Building a REST API with FastAPI
transcript: FastAPI is a modern Python web framework for building APIs. It leverages Python type hints for automatic validation and documentation generation. In this tutorial we will build a complete REST API from scratch covering path parameters query parameters request bodies response models dependency injection and authentication. We will also cover async database access with SQLAlchemy and write integration tests using pytest and httpx. By the end you will have a production-ready API structure.
notes: Key concepts: path operations, Pydantic models, dependency injection, OAuth2 with JWT, async SQLAlchemy sessions, pytest fixtures for testing.

workflows.name: Scaffold a new FastAPI project
steps: Create a virtual environment: python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate
Install dependencies: pip install fastapi uvicorn sqlalchemy asyncpg pydantic
Create main.py with FastAPI() app instance
Define Pydantic models for request/response in schemas.py

workflows.name: Add JWT authentication
steps: Install python-jose and passlib: pip install python-jose[cryptography] passlib[bcrypt]
Create auth.py with password hashing and JWT token generation
